question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle DBC\), \(BC=BC\) (common side), \(\angle ABC=\angle DBC\), and \(\angle ACB=\angle DCB\). Which criterion is used to prove that the two triangles are congruent?

solutions.explanation: \(BC\) is the included side between \(\angle ABC\) and \(\angle ACB\). Two angles and their included side are respectively equal, so use ASA.
solutions.title: Identify the included side
